summary: Storm damage: Willowview Trail closed; Redtail Trail closed between Brandon and Grass Valley; 300 feet of Brandon Trail inaccessible to equestrians.
location: Willowview Trail; Redtail Trail; Brandon Trail between Horseshoe Trail and Stone Bridge
detail: EBRPD asks riders to plan alternative routes on the Brandon stretch. No reopening date given for any of the three.

summary: A section of Bird Trail is PERMANENTLY closed; the trail no longer forms its own loop.
detail: Re-routed since 2025-08-04 to connect back to MacDonald Trail, giving a smaller loop in combination with it. Recorded as an advisory because that is where EBRPD publishes it, but it is permanent rather than a condition -- it will not expire, and a map older than August 2025 shows a loop that is not there.

summary: Trail damage at two Briones Crest junctions -- passable with care, not closed.
location: Briones Crest Trail / Mott Peak Trail and Briones Crest Trail / Lagoon Trail junctions
detail: Barricades and cones are posted at both ends of the fire trail. EBRPD asks users to follow signage and use caution. Kept as caution rather than a closure because the agency's own wording is 'damaged but passable'.
No reason or reopening date given. Sunol Backpack Camp sits on the Ohlone Wilderness Trail in this preserve, so a route planned through Shady Glen needs an alternative.

summary: Hardy Canyon Trail is closed until further notice, for storm damage.
detail: Round Valley Backpack Camp is in this preserve and its water supply is separately out of service; that outage is in the water ledger rather than here, because water availability has a table of its own that records dated checks.

summary: Caution Advisory for blue-green algae at the WEST swim beach.
detail: Blue-green algae advisories move between caution and danger week to week and clear faster than a month, so this is among the shortest-lived facts in this project. Ordinance 38 s.801.1 already bars every animal from bathing beaches, leashed or not, so a dog or cat is not affected by the advisory -- it was never allowed there.

summary: Caution Advisory for blue-green algae at the EAST swim beach.
detail: Posted separately from the west beach; the two are advised independently.

summary: Golden mussels detected at Contra Loma: a boat launched there is quarantined for 30 days from Del Valle and other inspected lakes.
detail: Clean, drain and dry any vessel before launching anywhere. Boat bands are honoured only at the lake that issued them. Recorded against Del Valle rather than Contra Loma because Del Valle is the park this project holds; the detection itself is at Contra Loma, which is also where Star Mine Group Camp parties park, and neither Contra Loma nor Lake Chabot has a row here for their own advisories to attach to.

summary: Dry Creek Garden is closed until further notice, for storm damage.
location: Dry Creek Garden, end of May Road, Union City
detail: Posted on the park page as 'Due to storm damage Dry Creek Garden is closed until further notice.' The garden's published hours are Thursday to Saturday 10am-4pm, so the hours and the closure sit on the same page and only the closure is current. Rated INFO rather than caution because it shuts an attraction, not a route or a camp: nothing about Arroyo Flats depends on it. It does close one of the park's two disabled-parking areas, the Dry Creek Garden lot at the end of May Road in Union City -- whether that lot is closed with the garden is not stated. The fourth storm-damage closure in this table, after two at Anthony Chabot, one at Briones and one at Round Valley.
